name: Feature Request / Funktionswunsch
about: Suggest a new merge policy, projection contract, or CLI/API improvement
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: ["enhancement", "needs-triage"]
assignees: []
---

## Problem Statement / Problemstellung
Describe the synchronization, verification, or discoverability gap you want to solve.

## Proposed Solution / Vorgeschlagener Lösungsweg
Describe the API, CLI flag, or merge/retention behavior while preserving local-first and zero-core-dependency guarantees.

## Compatibility & Safety Impact
- [ ] Preserves zero external dependencies for core `push`/`pull` mode
- [ ] Preserves fail-closed path containment and dry-run defaults where applicable
